## How to test

- [ ] (if UI) Checked both CP2077 and Synthwave themes
- [ ] (if UI) Checked both EN and 中 language
- [ ] (if filewriter / native host) Re-ran `npm run native-host:install -- <id>` and confirmed `ext_save_to_local` works
